---
name: Start Orchestrated Delivery
description: "Start or resume evidence-based multi-agent delivery with generic isolated subagents, phase gates, approved UI mockups, independent critique, and persistent recovery records."
agent: delivery-orchestrator
argument-hint: "State the objective or say: Resume from the orchestration ledger."
---

Follow [the delivery orchestration playbook](../../docs/05-implementation/orchestration/README.md).

If this is a new initiative, establish its baseline and initialize the records from the templates before delegating implementation. If this is a resumed initiative, read repo memory, the master status, active workstream handoffs, and Git state before proposing or executing the next action.

Use generic isolated subagents only. Do not invoke repository `ai-*` role agents unless I explicitly request one. Require explicit mockup approval before every frontend phase and an independent rigorous critique before closing every phase.
